title: Six Cubs and a Net
lines: Ben and Dad sit on a log.
"A fox has cubs in a den," said Dad.
"Can I see the cubs?" said Ben.
"Yes, but do not run," said Dad.
Ben has a bug net. He taps Dad on a leg.
"Sit. The cubs are not up yet," said Dad.
Ben sits. Ten bugs hop on his net.
Six cubs hop up at the den!
scoring_note: This passage says "do not", "are not". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "don't" or "aren't" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
